name: WCEET annual funding round
summary: A yearly funding round for practical ecological projects in the Lake Taupo and Waikato River catchments in New Zealand, such as wetland and riparian restoration, planting, fencing and pest control.

geography.label: Lake Taupo and Waikato River catchments

steps: Present application in person, if required

eligibility.rule: Applying for a project that has not already been completed

documents: Written quotes for goods and services to be purchased
A4 site map or aerial photo showing the project boundary
Landowner permission, if the project is not on the applicant's land

calls.label: Annual round
calls.recurring: Applications are due by 31 March each year

status.quote: WCEET has one funding round per year. Applications must be received by 31st March of each year.

recurring.quote: WCEET has one funding round per year. Applications must be received by 31st March of each year.

applicant_types.quote: assists organisations, agencies and individuals with projects which foster and enhance the sustainable management of ecological resources

eligibility.quote: Grants will be made for charitable purposes only.
Projects will not be funded if they have already been completed.

after_award.quote: Reports on the status of your project are required by 31 March each year.
